question: With 24 eight-step supervised causal episodes and eight veto-only CHECK episodes, do observed interventions uniquely constrain hidden causal rules, and if so do the sequence-aware recurrent models fit and generalize under an unchanged optimization budget?
mechanism_scope: separate abstract 8-bit synthetic hypothesis family; never import any prior experiment source law or original case and never claim exact equivalence with unknown prospective families

regimes.dense: synthetic source-to-target nonlinear state interaction, branch on event parity, each branch governed by one 4-bit hidden key
regimes.sparse: same nontrivial source-to-target base law but one hidden key affects only target=alpha/source=gamma/event=0; remaining key governs others

prespecified_fixture.ground_truth_hidden_key_choice: seed-derived private-to-engineering-diagnostic deterministic; not experimental first-use and never scientific external oracle
prespecified_fixture.finite_version_space_result: enumerate ALL 256 explicit hypotheses, count consistency over entire ordered episodes and resulting counterfactual heldout disagreement
prespecified_fixture.symbolic_class_oracle: strong grammar-aware information diagnostic, not an equally trained deployable model; cannot count as candidate scientific competitor

comparators.longer_probe_conclusion_limit: engineering optimization sensitivity diagnostic only, not new model selection; never changes prospective frozen model or tunes on consumed first-use outcomes
metrics: exact grammar-consistent version space at each episode budget
heldout causal trajectory disagreement among surviving hypotheses
frozen 45-epoch FIT loss reduction and CHECK bit error
comparators.separate_information_vs_representation_v: Only report what each intervention establishes. Identifiability under assumed grammar does not establish learner capacity, and failure of gradient methods does not prove representational impossibility. Distinguish inferences explicitly.
